item.title: ABC News: Car parking a key concern in battleground Victorian seat
item.description: The ABC visits the east Melbourne seat of Glen Waverley, where the Suburban Rail Loop, potholes and the cost of living are major issues two months out from polling day.

item.title: ABC News: Aussie breaks 24-year-old world record at national short course swimming titles
item.description: Two-time Paralympic gold medallist Rowan Crothers creates history at the Australian Short Course Championships in Sydney.

item.title: ABC News: Weapons makers and SpaceX in government's key investment fund portfolio
item.description: The federal government has quietly published the Future Fund's half-yearly report and it reveals a portfolio that includes weapons makers and SpaceX.

item.title: ABC News: Live: Taylor blames 'home-grown inflation' for 15-year-high rate hike
item.description: The opposition leader says the government is not in control of inflation and interest rates. Follow live.

item.title: ABC News: Double murder charge after bodies found at property two weeks apart
item.description: A man has been charged with murder after police discovered the bodies of two men at a remote property near Grafton weeks apart.

item.title: ABC News: Government moves on NDIS providers offering gifts in remote NT communities
item.description: The federal government is cracking down on NDIS providers offering residents in remote Northern Territory Aboriginal communities gifts, including food, alcohol and tobacco.

item.title: ABC News: Tangara carriages locked down over 'train surfing' and break-in fears
item.description: After multiple security breaches, the back carriage has been closed off on many Tangara trains.

item.title: ABC News: Four years since retail laws passed, but no help for cafe owner
item.description: A cafe owner in dispute over a building compliance issue may have to take their case to court, as a retail law passed four years ago is yet to be enacted.

item.title: ABC News: Manchester City found guilty in Premier League's biggest scandal
item.description: Manchester City is found guilty of arranging "sham" contracts as part of financial breaches that helped it dominate the sport, in what has become the biggest scandal in Premier League history.

item.title: ABC News: Inside the fossil fuel industry's push into Australian classrooms
item.description: At least 260 educational programs in Australia are sponsored by fossil fuel companies, according to a report by a climate advocacy group.

item.title: ABC News: Coober Pedy's transition out of administration delayed indefinitely
item.description: The South Australian government's timeline to transition the District Council of Coober Pedy out of administration is set to be discarded — without any new end date being set.

item.title: ABC News: When are the Dally M Awards? Who is the favourite?
item.description: The NRL's and NRLW's best gather in Sydney tonight to crown rugby league's biggest stars at the Dally M Awards. Here is what you need to know.

item.title: ABC News: Six babies die in Qld in three years after contracting syphilis in the womb
item.description: New Queensland Health data shows 55 pregnant women have been diagnosed with the sexually transmitted disease so far this year.

item.title: ABC News: Battery customers feeling 'ripped off' after solar company collapses
item.description: A Sydney solar company has collapsed, leaving large numbers of customers furious after they paid hefty deposits for battery systems under a multi-billion-dollar federal government scheme.

item.title: ABC News: 16yo, men charged with murder after Sydney mistaken-identity shooting
item.description: A teenage boy and two men have been charged over the mistaken-identity shooting of a university student in Sydney's south-west earlier this month.
